payload.description_html:
Simplified cladogram of Dinosauria with the distribution of feathers according to the fossil record. Despite its more ancient origin, it was only in maniraptoriformes that modern-type feathers (pennaceous feathers) have arisen (Based in Xu & Guo, 2009; Clarke,

2013; Godefroit et al., 2013; Han et al., 2014; Koshchowitz et al., 2014).
